content.title: About
content.content: Mushroom corn is a puffed corn snack infused with natural mushroom extract. The product is certified organic, non‑GMO, and contains no artificial flavors or colors. It has a light, crunchy texture and a subtle earthy mushroom aroma.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The mushroom flavor comes from real mushroom extract, not synthetic additives.
Puffs are made by air‑expansion without added oil.
The snack is fully vegan and suitable for vegetarians.
Organic certification guarantees the corn was grown without pesticides or synthetic fertilizers.
Mushroom corn is often used in Asian cuisine as a crunchy garnish.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: Air‑puffing results in minimal fat content, making it a light snack option.

items.title: Source of dietary fiber
items.content: Corn provides fiber that supports digestion and satiety.

items.title: Rich in B‑vitamins
items.content: Contains thiamine, niacin, and folate, which are important for energy metabolism.

items.title: Antioxidant properties of mushrooms
items.content: Mushroom extract adds polyphenols that help combat oxidative stress.

items.title: Immune support
items.content: Beta‑glucans from mushrooms may help strengthen the immune system.

items.title: Mushroom allergy
items.content: Individuals allergic to mushrooms may experience reactions when consuming this snack.

items.title: High glycemic index
items.content: Puffed corn can raise blood sugar quickly, so people with diabetes should monitor portion size.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Some varieties may contain added salt; those watching sodium intake should check the label.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Enjoy the puffs as a standalone snack, mix them into granola, yogurt, salads, or use as a crunchy topping for soups and Asian dishes.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep in a sealed package in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. For extended freshness, store in the refrigerator to maintain crunch and flavor.
